description.narrative: It is expected that the grant would finance the following activities: a. Generation and consolidation of knowledge on social assistance and poverty reduction. The grant will support a series of in-depth case studies and evaluations, following a science of delivery approach, focused on implementation issues and innovation in social assistance and productive inclusion programs. Possible candidates include: (i) the design and operation of the registry of beneficiaries (cadastro único) of the Bolsa Família program, including recent efforts to reduce exclusion of marginalized groups through and active search process (busca ativa); (ii) implementation of the Brasil Carinhoso program, which increases cash benefits to families with young children and seeks to expand access to early childhood education; (iii) successes and challenges in expanding social assistance services to vulnerable population groups as a complement to cash transfers and other benefits; (iv) state and municipal governments innovations to establish cash transfer programs that complement the Bolsa Família program; and (v) successes and challenges in scaling up and achieving impact with productive inclusion programs at federal and local level (training, labor intermediation, microcredit, support to rural producers, etc.). In addition, the grant may support a research competition to stimulate new research on innovations related to the Brasil sem Miséria plan using a SoD approach, as well as a platform to facilitate access to relevant data and information for researchers. b. More effective south-south knowledge exchange. The grant will support work by the MDS to develop a more systematic and effective approach to south-south knowledge exchange, including online learning material for delegations to access prior to visits, as well as improved documentation for south-south visits based on existing material as well as new studies (see point (a). c. Training and knowledge exchange for Brazilian researchers and practitioners. The grant will support the development of a platform and approach for knowledge exchange, focused on both practitioners and researchers at state and municipal level. The platform may include access to online training material. d. Conferences, workshops and other events. The grant will support conferences and workshop related to stimulate knowledge exchange and learning about the implementation of different elements of the Brasil sem Miséria plan.
